sections.heading: Variants
sections.text: Hallo, wenn es sich einrichten lässt, ja. :: Hello, if it can be arranged, yes. Ich komme, wenn es sich einrichten lässt. :: I'll come if I can make it work.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: A polite yes with a condition: you would like it, but you understand it may not always work. wenn möglich is shorter.
